instructions: Run only on a georeferenced raster whose six bands are explicitly ordered BLUE, GREEN, RED, NIR_NARROW, SWIR_1, SWIR_2.
Return a source-space burned-area mask and its WGS84 polygon derived exclusively from the raster geotransform.
Preserve acquisition time, product identity, reference digest and uncertainty in every proposal.
Abstain when band order, raster georeferencing, cloud quality or model output is not defensible.
Treat absence or abstention as local to this auxiliary stage; preserve RGB satellite, thermal, hotspot, fusion and reporting paths.
forbidden_outputs: Do not infer burned area from an RGB preview, screenshot or terrestrial photograph.
Do not treat a burn scar as a current active-fire front.
Do not invent a CRS, geotransform, band order or geographic polygon.
